title: EnforceShield — software that finds counterfeit listings and clone sites and runs the takedowns itself
money_note: EUR 1.7M seed round announced 2026-09-15 (tech.eu, the url), led by Vendep Capital with FIRSTPICK VC; stated in EUR, no FX needed.
summary: Vilnius-based EnforceShield sells a SaaS platform that detects online infringements of a brand's intellectual property — counterfeit listings, unauthorised sellers, cloned storefronts, impersonation and phishing pages — then analyses each case and executes the takedown, with lawyers reviewing outcomes rather than processing routine cases. It raised a EUR 1.7M seed round in September 2026 led by Vendep Capital.
notes: TRANSFER LOGIC: the buyer is a brand or retailer with IP to defend, and Czech brands have the same exposure — cloned storefronts and fake listings. MPO warned in 2026 that links to fraudulent e-shops copying the sites of well-known Czech retailers were circulating (mpo.gov.cz/cz/ochrana-spotrebitele/aktualni-informace/ceskem-se-siri-odkazy-na-podvodne-e-shopy--ktere-kopiruji-weby-znamych-obchodu--289453/), and Alza publishes its own account of pursuing a copycat shop by commissioning an expert report documenting 33 identically described products (alza.cz/article/241.htm) — i.e. the Czech answer today is a manual, per-case legal one. URGENCY 0: no dated instrument obliges the RIGHTSHOLDER to do this. The DSA's notice-and-action duties bind the platform, not the brand, so the driver is commercial loss, not a deadline; scored 0 rather than borrowing a platform-side duty. SCALE 2 (brands and e-shops as a sector). RECURRENCE 2 (monitoring is continuous, never a one-off). MATURITY (abroad): EARLY — founded 2024 by attorney Rytis Rudzinskas, seed stage, so the >=3-years-selling limb fails; the traction limb is met (the url states 20+ enterprise customers and an average of 33,500+ violations removed per month). CZ CHECK: Czech-language queries, all run 2026-09-21 via session web search: (1) 'ochrana značky online monitoring padělků stahování falešných nabídek e-shopy služba pro firmy'; (2) 'automatizované vymáhání ochranných známek online takedown falešných e-shopů česká firma software'; (3) 'monitoring internetu porušování práv duševního vlastnictví značky Alza Marketplace stahování nabídek agentura Česko'. Surfaces: Czech-language web search, ARES name search, data/signals/funded/*.jsonl (no EnforceShield, no online-IP-enforcement record), data/lookup/cz-contract-parties.jsonl. FOUND: Patentoid s.r.o. (ICO 04821645, datumVzniku 2016-02-17) sells trademark WATCHING — algorithmic alerts on colliding trademark APPLICATIONS (patentoid.cz/watching/, saved as pages/cz-patentoid-watching.html) — competes: adjacent (registry collision monitoring, not marketplace takedowns); maturity: established on the years limb (since 2016), second limb not shown, 0 hits in cz-contract-parties.jsonl. Hlídač ochranných známek (hlidacoz.cz, saved as pages/cz-hlidacoz.html) — same registry-watching category — competes: adjacent; maturity: not shown (no operating ICO stated on the page, so not ARES-resolved). SGS Czech Republic, s.r.o. (ICO 48589241, datumVzniku 1993-03-08) sells an 'ochrana značky' brand-protection service covering e-commerce monitoring (sgs.com/cs-cz/nase-sluzby/konektivita-a-produkty/ochrana-znacky) — competes: adjacent (a global inspection group's service engagement, physical supply chain first, not a detection-to-takedown platform); maturity: established (since 1993; one public buyer line in cz-contract-parties.jsonl, smlouvy-36832634, 2026-08-17, EUR 11,384). ČOI's risky-e-shop database and browser extension — competes: adjacent, and it protects the consumer, not the brand. IP law firms (holec-advokati.cz, elegal.cz) sell IP enforcement as billed legal work — competes: adjacent (manual, per case). VERDICT: absent — no Czech vendor found selling automated detection-to-takedown enforcement across marketplaces and clone sites; what exists is registry watching, a global inspection group's service, and law firms billing per case. POSITIVE CONTROL (run 2026-09-21 by this pass, two limbs): (a) ARES name search 'Wultra' -> Wultra s.r.o., ICO 03643174, datumVzniku 2014-12-15 — the ARES method surfaces a known small Czech software vendor. (b) A descriptive Czech-language query in a neighbouring domain, 'právní podpora pro firmy předplatné advokát online paušál pro malé a střední podniky', surfaced Dostupný advokát s.r.o. (ICO 09788336, dostupnyadvokat.cz, which publishes '150+ nových zákazníků každý měsíc') and advokatbenes.cz's právní paušál priced from 6 600 Kč/měsíc — so the Czech descriptive method does surface real Czech vendors where they exist. PASSED.
quote: EnforceShield currently serves more than 20 enterprise customers and says its platform removes an average of more than 33,500 IP violations per month across its e-commerce customer base.

title: AcademyAI — measures whether employees can actually use AI, then trains the gaps it finds
money_note: GBP 1.65M oversubscribed pre-seed announced 2026-09-15 (tech.eu, the url); converted at the ECB reference rate GBP/EUR 1.1644 for 2026-09-18 (api.frankfurter.app, fetched 2026-09-21, saved as pages/fx-gbp-eur.json) -> EUR 1,921,260.
summary: AcademyAI assesses employees against a six-axis AI-capability framework — critical thinking, judgement, prompting, judging AI output, practical skills — and then delivers five-minute, role-specific training for the gaps, with dashboards for managers. It raised a GBP 1.65M pre-seed in September 2026 from Nexus Family Office and Panthera Family Office.
notes: TRANSFER LOGIC: the buyer is any employer whose staff use AI tools, and a Czech driver is on the books: article 4 of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (AI Act) obliges providers and deployers to ensure a sufficient level of AI literacy among their staff, in force since 2 February 2025, with the sanctions and supervisory-authority provisions applying from 2 August 2025 and the remaining provisions from 2 August 2026 (epravo.cz ID 120133, 26.9.2025, saved as pages/cz-epravo-ai-gramotnost.html). URGENCY 2: the duty is in force and binds Czech employers, but no enforcement action on article 4 was found. SCALE 3 (cross-sector: the duty and the tool-rollout it follows touch every employer using AI). RECURRENCE 3 (the obligation is permanent and the skill has to be kept current as the tools change). NOTE AGAINST OUR OWN CASE: the same epravo analysis states the AI Act does NOT itself require measuring the level of knowledge, nor a certificate — so the measurement half of this product is a recommended practice, not a mandated one, and the record should not be read as saying otherwise. MATURITY (abroad): EARLY — pre-seed, platform being developed, no customers or customer count in the url. (ICO 27902587, datumVzniku 2007-05-29) sells an 'AI Copilot Specialist' certified course (tx.cz/ai/ai-copilot-specialist) — competes: direct on training; maturity: established on the years limb, second limb not shown. Skřivánek (skrivanek.cz/cz/ai/skoleni-ai-pro-firmy/) sells AI courses for company teams — competes: direct on training; maturity: NOT ARES-resolved (the ARES name search 'Skřivánek' returns 290 subjects and no single matching s.r.o., so no maturity claim is made). NOT FOUND: any Czech vendor selling the measurement layer — an AI-capability assessment with per-employee, per-team dashboards. title: Octostar — an investigator's platform for police, courts and financial-crime teams that runs air-gapped
money_note: Seed extension announced 2026-04-06 (EU-Startups, the url) bringing TOTAL funding to EUR 6.1M; the extension tranche itself was not disclosed, so money_eur is cumulative funding, not this round. Stated in EUR, no FX needed.
summary: Galway-headquartered Octostar sells national security, law-enforcement and financial institutions an investigation platform combining link analysis, communications and document intelligence and GenAI agents, able to run entirely air-gapped with no cloud or external data exposure. Its seed extension in April 2026 brought total funding to EUR 6.1M, with Milan's The Techshop joining.
notes: TRANSFER LOGIC: the buyers are police forces, judicial bodies, ministries and financial-crime units, and Czechia has all of them with the same problem — investigators searching large, badly structured data sets by hand. A Czech dated driver exists: the remaining provisions of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (AI Act), which include the high-risk regime covering law-enforcement AI, apply from 2 August 2026 (epravo.cz ID 120133, saved as pages/cz-epravo-ai-gramotnost.html); sovereignty and air-gapped deployment are what the product sells against that. URGENCY 2: in force and binding on the deployer, no enforcement action found. SCALE 2 (public-sector investigation as a sector). RECURRENCE 2 (casework is continuous, not a one-off purchase). MATURITY (abroad): EARLY on the test — founded 2023, so under the >=3-years-selling limb; the traction limb is met (the url states three new deployments in EU national law-enforcement and judicial bodies completed in Q1 2026, 15+ expected by year end, plus announced joint work with BAE Systems). CZ CHECK: Czech-language queries run 2026-09-21 via session web search: (1) 'analytický software pro vyšetřování propojování dat odhalování podvodů policie a úřady český dodavatel'; (2) 'český software pro analýzu vazeb mezi osobami a firmami pro úřady obce vyšetřování dotačních podvodů komerční řešení'. Surfaces: Czech-language web search, ARES name search, data/signals/funded/*.jsonl, data/lookup/cz-contract-parties.jsonl (0 hits for the integrators below). FOUND: LikPik, built by Tomáš Rebok's team at the Institute of Computer Science, Masaryk University, under the AFoLab project funded by the Ministry of the Interior's security research programme, and in use by Policie ČR since autumn 2023 — it cleans and organises unsorted investigative data and searches tens of billions of records in seconds, and the Police Presidium is quoted endorsing it (ics.muni.cz/aktuality/likpik-cesky-software-pomaha-policejnim-vysetrovatelum-odhalovat-zlocince, 30.10.2023, saved as pages/cz-likpik-muni.html) — competes: direct on the data-organisation and search step; maturity: EARLY as a market offering — it is a university research output with no selling company, no commercial customers and no vendor ICO found, so it fails the established test for want of a seller, not for want of quality. Jednotný analytický nástroj (JAN): the police president Martin Vondrášek announced the police would build its own umbrella tool to link the outputs of its different information systems (digitalnisvobody.cz, 29.1.2024, saved as pages/cz-digitalnisvobody-jan.html) — competes: direct, and it is the largest buyer building in-house, which is the single biggest risk to this model in CZ; maturity: not a vendor. Profinit EU, s.r.o. (ICO 04434081, datumVzniku 2015-09-25) and DATASYS s.r.o. (ICO 61249157, datumVzniku 1994-05-09) deliver bespoke data and integration work to the Czech public sector — competes: adjacent (project delivery, not an investigator's product); maturity: established on the years limb, second limb not shown, 0 hits each in cz-contract-parties.jsonl. Commercial link analysis over public registers (rejstrik-firem.kurzy.cz, ORNetFace) — competes: adjacent (company-relationship graphs for commercial due diligence, not case files, intercepts or air-gapped deployment). Policie ČR's own answer under zákon č. 106/1999 Sb. names the state IS Digitálních podob osob for face recognition (policie.gov.cz/clanek/analyticke-nastroje.aspx, saved as pages/cz-policie-analyticke-nastroje.html) — a state system, not a vendor platform. VERDICT: contested — direct Czech tooling exists but it is state-built or university-built, and no ESTABLISHED Czech commercial vendor selling an investigator's platform was found; a builder's real opponent here is the buyer's own in-house programme, not a competitor. title: DeskAmigo — turns a café's or hotel's dead hours into workspace someone books by the half day
money_note: EUR 350,000 pre-seed announced 2026-09-15 (Portugal Startup News, the url) from undisclosed Portuguese and British entrepreneurs in hospitality, F&B and real estate; stated in EUR, no FX needed.
summary: DeskAmigo is a marketplace where cafés, restaurants, hotels, gyms and studios list the space they are not using at quiet times and remote workers book it by the half or full day, with the venue setting its own prices and availability. It raised EUR 350,000 pre-seed in September 2026 after interviewing around 250 Portuguese café and restaurant owners.
notes: TRANSFER LOGIC: two Czech buyers, both present. On the supply side, Czech cafés and hotels carry the same dead hours between services; on the demand side, freelancers and remote employees need somewhere to work for a few hours without a coworking membership. The Czech price point for exactly this already exists: Kavárna 6,33 in Prague 8 sells a shared office seat at 100 Kč/hod, a whole day at 633 Kč and packages of 40/80/100 hours for 2 500–5 000 Kč (k633.cz/zarohem/, saved as pages/cz-k633-zarohem.html) — one venue doing by hand what this company aggregates. URGENCY 0: no dated instrument. SCALE 1 (a niche segment: hospitality venues with idle daytime capacity plus the remote workers who would book them), and the record survives materiality on money, not on scale. RECURRENCE 2 (bookings recur; the idle capacity recurs daily). MATURITY (abroad): EARLY — pre-seed, Portugal only, no venue or booking count published in the url. CZ CHECK: Czech-language query run 2026-09-21 via session web search: 'rezervace místa na práci v kavárně nebo hotelu na hodinu aplikace pro práci na dálku Česko coworking marketplace'. Surfaces: Czech-language web search, ARES name search, data/signals/funded/*.jsonl (no DeskAmigo and no Czech idle-space marketplace record), data/lookup/cz-contract-parties.jsonl (0 hits for the players below). FOUND: WorkLounge s.r.o. (ICO 05204984, datumVzniku 2016-06-29, with WorkLounge Prague s.r.o. ICO 06541682 and WorkLounge Dejvice s.r.o. ICO 21277401) sells Hot Desk memberships and in-app booking of desks and meeting rooms across its own Prague branches (worklounge.com/clenstvi/karlin/hot-desk) — competes: adjacent (it operates its own dedicated coworking space and sells memberships; it does not list third-party idle hospitality space); maturity: established on the years limb, second limb not shown. Spaces 'Cowork na hodinu' (spacesworks.com/cs/coworking/cowork-by-the-hour) sells hourly access through an app — competes: adjacent (again its own dedicated centres); maturity: established, but it is the international IWG group's Czech presence, not ARES-resolved here. WHATSPOT s.r.o. (ICO 17855047, datumVzniku 2022-12-20) sells a Czech booking system for meeting rooms and desks (whatspot.app/cs, saved as pages/cz-whatspot.html) — competes: adjacent (software an employer runs over its OWN rooms, no marketplace, no venue supply); maturity: EARLY (over three years old but no named customers, public count, Series A or state listing found). EasyWeek (easyweek.cz/business/solutions/coworking) sells coworking booking software — competes: adjacent (software, not a demand marketplace); maturity: not ARES-resolved, foreign vendor. Kavárna 6,33 / Coworking Za rohem — competes: direct on the supply side, but it is one venue selling its own seats, not an aggregator; maturity: early. VERDICT: absent for the aggregator — Czech venues sell hourly work seats one at a time and Czech operators sell memberships in their own space, but no Czech marketplace was found pooling third-party café, hotel and gym capacity into hourly bookings.
